stats.fact: The awesome-claude-code curated resource list has grown past 52,000 GitHub stars, reflecting massive community demand for learning materials around agentic coding tools.

Anthropic maintains an official directory of Claude Code plugins/skills (claude-plugins-official), establishing 'skills' as the standard packaging format for teaching agents reusable, versionable procedures.

Open-source agent training curricula like ai-agent-camp are explicitly designed for non-engineers and ship with security guardrail tooling (verify_integrity.py) because running agents grants shell, file-write, and external-API permissions.

Agent skill packs now span from beginner to expert (e.g. skillpacks, full-stack-design-skills), showing a maturing 'curriculum' ecosystem where organizations encode their coding standards as agent skills.
